column1: # Candidate Greek interlinear card data — pilot: John 6:50-51 (Byzantine / Robinson-Pierpont).
# STATUS: these are pilot *candidates* awaiting project-maintainer approval, not approved text.
# Editable source of truth for data/reviewed-greek-gloss.{json,js}.
#   book chapter verse token surface strongs morphology transliteration gloss source_note status
# token is 1-based and must match the token order in data/byz-interlinear.json.
# surface / strongs / morphology must byte-match the Byzantine token after NFC normalization;
#   the build script refuses to run otherwise.
# status (last column, always present so no row ends in a trailing tab):
#   candidate-pilot-blank  -> gloss must be empty (intentional no-gloss; NOT missing data)
# A token with no row at all is "missing" (runtime falls back to the Strong's-derived gloss).
# Transliteration: macrons for eta/omega (ē/ō), dropped accents/breathings except rough breathing.
# English glosses are contextual candidates, not copied positionally from any other edition.
